pairs.subject: trust-base
pairs.evidence: scripts/census/lib/engine.mjs:14 The context is plain untyped Node .mjs (a file walk + regex/import matcher + baseline ratchet) with no prover, no trusted bodies, no unsafe/assume escapes, no marker impls and no type-checker overrides; a search of scripts/census for 'unsafe', '@ts-ignore', '@ts-expect-error', 'prover', 'trusted' found 0 hits, and the repo's tsconfig include list (**/*.ts, **/*.tsx, **/*.mts) does not cover .mjs, so no checker reaches these files and there is no trust-base perimeter to manage.

techniques.evidence: scripts/census/run-census.mjs:16 This 'census' counts rule-matched source files against golden-path baselines, not escape-marker members of a trust base; there is no language-revision pin or unchecked-type escape census here.
scripts/census/self-test.mjs:21 There is an outside fixture self-test of the engine, but no function body is marked trusted to a prover, so the technique's precondition does not hold.
scripts/census/lib/engine.mjs:27 Engine imports only node built-ins; no prover or specification library is added to any package.
scripts/census/self-test.mjs:29 The CRLF concern is a runtime matcher behaviour pinned by a fixture test, not a platform fact a proof or type-level argument depends on.
